transcript: This outdoor bed in the middle of the desert was supposed to be the highlight of our trip through Africa. We booked a night at this remote lodge thinking it was one of the coolest places to sleep in the world. Picture it, cuddling under the Milky Way, sleeping beneath the best night sky you've ever seen. And that did happen. This is an unedited Star Labs. It was awesome. But first, we had to survive the beetle apocalypse. They don't advertise this on their website. earlier while watching the beautiful namib sunset these little green beetles started flying at us from every direction not just a few hundreds we were told they were harmless and that they disappear soon so we tried to embrace it but then we went back to our cozy bed and found it completely taken over beetles in the sheets the pillow everywhere at that point all we could do is laugh I pulled up my hood to keep them out of my ears and just accepted it no this wasn't what we expected but the next one we laughed over coffee with our bestie and all agreed this was the most memorable night of the whole trip. I don't even think I would change it if I could. Tag someone you'd want to be covered in bugs with.
metadata_caption: These are a different kind of bed bugs 😅 one of my favorite scenes from our Namibia documentary🪲
